author: KEXP
description: Doused in denim, 7-piece rock group DOOM GONG create a sonic world steeped in psychedelia, jazz, prog rock, and bedroom pop. In our latest in-studio session with host DJ Jewel, the band share a performance of "MEGAGONG" and more.
title: DOOM GONG performs "MEGAGONG" & more Live on KEXP
